invariants.description: mass balance: C_P(t_end) - C_P(0) = integral of (sum of face fluxes + flux_c)/V_P + M_reduced dt (trapezoid; 1e-3 of the total change plus 1e-8 of |C_P|)
invariants.expr: abs((C_P[-1] - C_P[0]) - np.trapz(((fN__J_down + fW__J_down + fS__J_up + fE__J_up) + flux_c)/V_P + M*C_P/(C_P + C50), t)) <= 1e-3*np.ptp(C_P) + 1e-8*np.max(np.abs(C_P)) + 1e-15

invariants.description: steady state reached by t_end: net flux + consumption balance (below 1e-6 of the largest flux term per volume)
invariants.expr: abs(((fN__J_down + fW__J_down + fS__J_up + fE__J_up)[-1] + flux_c)/V_P[-1] + M*C_P[-1]/(C_P[-1] + C50)) <= 1e-6*max(abs(M), (fN__D + fW__D + fS__D + fE__D)[-1]*max(np.max(fN__C_up), np.max(fW__C_up), np.max(fS__C_down), np.max(fE__C_down), np.max(C_P))/V_P[-1] + abs(flux_c)/V_P[-1], 1e-12)

invariants.description: with consumption only (M <= 0) and non-negative boundary concentrations and flux, C_P stays in [0, max(C_P_init, C_inf)], C_inf the no-consumption steady state
invariants.expr: (M > 0) or (np.all(C_P >= -1e-8*np.max(np.abs(C_P)) - 1e-15) and np.all(C_P <= max(C_P_init, ((fN__D*fN__C_up + fW__D*fW__C_up + fS__D*fS__C_down + fE__D*fE__C_down)[0] + flux_c)/(fN__D + fW__D + fS__D + fE__D)[0]) + 1e-8*np.max(np.abs(C_P)) + 1e-15))

invariants.description: exact solution when M = 0: C_P = C_inf + (C_P_init - C_inf) exp(-t sum D_k/V_P) (relative 1e-5)
invariants.expr: (M != 0) or (np.max(np.abs(C_P - (((fN__D*fN__C_up + fW__D*fW__C_up + fS__D*fS__C_down + fE__D*fE__C_down)[0] + flux_c)/(fN__D + fW__D + fS__D + fE__D)[0] + (C_P_init - ((fN__D*fN__C_up + fW__D*fW__C_up + fS__D*fS__C_down + fE__D*fE__C_down)[0] + flux_c)/(fN__D + fW__D + fS__D + fE__D)[0])*np.exp(-t*(fN__D + fW__D + fS__D + fE__D)[0]/V_P[0])))) <= 1e-5*max(np.max(np.abs(C_P)), 1e-9))

bc_sweep.rationale: the volume's own constants and flux_c; J_in and J_out are the summed face fluxes

baseline.reason: a single finite-volume cell has no measurable counterpart on its own; verified against the exact linear solution, mass balance and the steady state. Tissue PO2 data (e.g. CelayaAlcala2021 cortex) apply to an assembled grid of cells with capillaries.

calibrate.note: not_applicable: as baseline: calibration against tissue PO2 maps belongs to an assembled diffusion grid, not one cell
